SPECIFICATIONS

The engine exhaust gases flow into manifold (1) integral with catalytic converter (2) and then on to the front section of exhaust pipe (3). There is a flexible element (4) in the front section of the exhaust pipe to restrict the transmission of vibrations.

The rear exhaust pipe section consists of a silencer (5) connected to the silencers (6).

Special guards prevent heat radiating toward the body and fuel tank.
